newsitem.title: NIGERIA: African trade fair in Nigeria postponed until 1997.
newsitem.headline: African trade fair in Nigeria postponed until 1997.

text.p: An Organisation of African Unity trade fair planned for Nigeria in November has been postponed until March 1997, a government minister said on Tuesday.
"The venue and date of the fair had to be changed for logistic reasons," Rear Admiral Jubrila Ayinla, minister of commerce and tourism, told reporters.
Ayinla said the fair had been moved from Lagos, Nigeria's commercial hub, to the northern city of Kaduna because facilities in Lagos were sub-standard.
The fair is due to last from March 29 to April 6.
At least 350 million naira ($4.38 million) are to be spent upgrading Kaduna's trade fair complex and international airport.
The fair, held every four years, aims to increase trade between African countries, as well as encouraging outside business. The last was held in Zimbabwe in 1992.
